name: Example: keep a daily summary in an index
description: Every night counts yesterday's _internal events by host and sourcetype and writes them to the summary index with | collect, marked with the run id. Searching index=summary later is much faster than going back to the raw events. Change the index if yours is not called summary.

steps.name: Events by host and sourcetype
steps.spl:
index=_internal
| stats count AS events BY host, sourcetype
